dct_title_s: India: High Resolution Population Density Maps
dct_description_sm: Meta and Columbia University - CIESIN provide the High Resolution Settlement Layer as the world's most accurate population datasets. https://ai.meta.com/ai-for-good/datasets/high-resolution-population-density-maps/. This dataset for India, updated in 2026, relies on an updated methodology that uses the Overture Building Footprint dataset. These maps are the distribution of human population spanning India. Each of the 7 TIFF files is a 10 x 10 degree tile (the lower latitude coordinate and longitude coordinates are in the file name). A VRT file is also included.
